# HTTP contract snapshot. Rewrite with: go test ./tests/contract -update-contract
# Bodies are raw bytes after normalization (uuids, timestamps, tokens).

### 01 health: GET /health
status: 200
content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8
{"status":"ok","version":"0.1.0","deposit_scanner":{"status":"ok","pending":{},"pending_total":0}}

### 02 register without a body: POST /v1/auth/register
status: 400
content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8
{"error":{"code":"invalid_request","message":"invalid request body"}}

content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8
